subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: May the Models card present cross-provider same-name token totals that can include overlapping local and provider-reported source records, or must Scope B preserve source separation or deduplication before showing a global total?
rationale: The linked feature discussion identifies double counting as a central unresolved product and data-meaning question; tests cannot determine which user-facing aggregate is acceptable.

options.title: Require a source-safe aggregation contract
options.body: Define deduplication, source exclusion, or explicit opt-in semantics and update the presentation and tests before merging global totals.

options.title: Keep provider contributions separate
options.body: Retain model discovery and provenance but avoid a summed cross-provider total until a reliable deduplication rule exists.

options.title: Accept disclosed non-deduplicated estimates
options.body: Merge the current model totals only if maintainers explicitly accept them as potentially overlapping source estimates.

recommendation.title: Require a source-safe aggregation contract
recommendation.body: Define deduplication, source exclusion, or explicit opt-in semantics and update the presentation and tests before merging global totals.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level product direction is needed to choose the permanent meaning of the new aggregate metric.
